description: This file defines a utility class 'DispatcherTimerDelayer' that encapsulates a DispatcherTimer to provide delayed execution functionality with start, stop, and reset capabilities, and an event to trigger actions after the delay.

classes.name: DispatcherTimerDelayer
classes.description: A class that wraps a DispatcherTimer to provide delayed execution with start, stop, and reset methods, and an event to notify when the timer ticks.

methods.name: DispatcherTimerDelayer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DispatcherTimer with a specified interval and attaches the tick event handler.

methods.name: ResetAndStart
methods.description: Stops and then starts the timer, effectively resetting it.

methods.name: Timer_Tick
methods.description: Event handler invoked when the timer ticks; stops the timer and raises the Action event.
